summary: Use this when a production AcmeDB node needs a routine restart after a config change. It takes one node out of rotation at a time, so the cluster keeps serving reads and writes throughout. Do not use it for a node that is already down or failing its health check; that is an incident, not a restart.

steps.do: Take the node out of the load balancer pool
Wait for open connections to drop to zero
Restart the AcmeDB service on the node
Watch the health check go green
Put the node back in the load balancer pool
